newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on Japan demand, CBOT soybeans.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on Japan demand, CBOT soybeans.

text.p: WCE canola ended up on strong Japanese demand and firm CBOT soybean values, traders said.

"There was strong exporter interest and the beans were up, commercials covered shorts and there were light hedges," a trader said. Jan-Mar spread at $2.20, Mar-May $1.50, Jan-May $3.90. January futures crush margin rose to -34.24 from -34.82 Monday. Volume was moderate.
Japan bought 8,000-10,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
January canola rose $3.80 to $401.90. January flax fell $3.70 to $351 after commission sell stops were triggered at Monday's lows.
March feed wheat rose $0.50 to $169 as UGG bought, July rose $1.80 to $164.80 on commercial demand, traders said. Mar-July spread at $4. Oats and feed peas did not trade.
February western barley rose $1.60 at $136.70 on commercial support, March rose $0.20 to $134.70. Feb-Mar spread at $0.50.
(Values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats).
